script:
set -e
export DENO_INSTALL=$HOME/.deno
command -v $DENO_INSTALL/bin/deno >/dev/null 2>&1 || (curl -fsSL https://deno.land/install.sh | sh -s -- -y >/dev/null 2>&1)
cd /workspace/neural-landscape
git pull -q --ff-only || true
for F in $(ls public/flights/flight-03*.json | sed 's|public/flights/||; s|\.json||'); do
  echo "=== campaign render: $F (cache decides) ==="
  $DENO_INSTALL/bin/deno run --allow-read --allow-write --allow-net --allow-run --allow-env \
    --node-modules-dir=auto --unstable-webgpu \
    tools/offline-render.ts --flight=$F --fps=30 --width=1920 --height=1080 || echo "RENDER-FAILED $F"
done
echo CAMPAIGN-BACKFILL-DONE
